//: SNOW-899 — type-check static/js without compiling it.
The Python side has ruff and mypy enforced on every commit. The browser
side had three bespoke guards, each aimed at one historical bug class,
and nothing general. js-globals-lint in particular exists to catch reads
of a window global nothing assigns — a misspelled or wrongly-scoped
identifier, which is precisely what a type checker catches for free.
NOT a build step. noEmit is set, nothing here feeds bin/minify-js or
collectstatic, and no source file changes syntax: types are expressed as
JSDoc comments. See CLAUDE.md and docs/client-side-tests.md.
checkJs is FALSE on purpose. Opt-in is per file via a `// @ts-check`
line, so this lands green on thirteen files rather than red on 75 with a
suppression list. A new file is unchecked until someone opts it in.
